result.title: RetryRoute: Retry-Aware Model Routing for Agentic Image Editing Services
result.summary: Web agents increasingly edit images by calling open editing models in a critique-and-retry loop, and these models differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. After every rejected edit, a service must decide whether to retry the same model, escalate to another or give up. Existing routers pick one model per request, and cascades escalate in a fixed order. However, both treat a retry as an independent draw. We identify sticky failures, meaning that a retry after a failure succeeds only 17-53% as often as a first try across six open models, three benchmarks and two judges. Based on this finding, we propose RetryRoute, a retry-aware router that estimates each model's chance of success given the request's failure history. It plans retries, escalations and abandonment over failure states and adds live queue waits to the cost, so the same plan becomes load-aware dispatch. At the main budget, RetryRoute's success under the in-loop judge exceeds the strongest of eleven prior baselines by 2.8 points on average over eight groups. On a GPU serving testbed it raises the share of edits delivered within the service-level objective by 5.0-6.3 points over the best prior baseline at every load.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发现图像编辑模型重试存在「粘性失败」（失败后再试的成功率仅为首次尝试的 17–53%），据此提出 RetryRoute：在失败状态上规划重试、升级到其他模型或放弃，并把实时排队等待计入成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 将失败历史当作状态做重试/升级/放弃的序贯决策并显式权衡成本，与 LVR 中的停止决策、计算预算和成功信念估计可能有概念联系，可供核查；但研究对象是服务路由，不涉及视觉推理内部状态。
